subject.title: Make Google Chat DM thread sessions configurable

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's `channels.googlechat.threadSessions` config name and public `parentPeer` inbound-envelope SDK helper shape, or should Google Chat thread routing stay plugin-local or be consolidated with the broader thread-session plan?
rationale: Source review can verify the narrow implementation path, but accepting a new public config key and SDK helper parameter is a product/API contract decision that automation should not decide silently.

options.title: Accept Shape After Repair
options.body: Approve the default-off `threadSessions` config and `parentPeer` helper direction, then require rebase, regenerated baselines, and current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Routing Plugin-Local
options.body: Reject the SDK helper expansion and ask for a Google Chat-local implementation or an already-approved existing seam instead.

options.title: Consolidate Thread Work
options.body: Pause this PR and settle the option naming, DM versus Space scope, and remaining related work with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/68967 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44347.

recommendation.title: Accept Shape After Repair
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off `threadSessions` config and `parentPeer` helper direction, then require rebase, regenerated baselines, and current-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across Google Chat, routing, plugin SDK, and config-contract decisions touched by this PR.
